lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Transfer, reflection, and publication: fractions in measurement and sharing

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different setting than the problems below.

items.prompt: A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point 4 lengths from 0?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 4 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 3 lengths from 0?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 1 lengths from 0?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 8 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 4 lengths from 0?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 8 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 1 lengths from 0?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 2 lengths from 0?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 8 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 7 lengths from 0?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
